item.title: Sony Secures RAM Supply to Meet PS5 FY2026 Demand
item.description: Sony confirms enough GDDR6 RAM for its FY2026 PS5 forecast, easing “Ramageddon” worries as GTA 6’s November launch promises a holiday sales surge.
